title: Yū Shimizu's Howling Blaze Fantasy Light Novels Get Manga
content: The July issue of Kadokawa 's Comic Alive magazine revealed on Wednesday that Yū Shimizu 's Howling Blaze: Sōen no Kenshi to Fushi no Majo ( Howling Blaze: The Funeral Flame Blade & The Immortal Witch ) light novel series is inspiring a manga adaptation by koko that will launch in the magazine's next issue on June 26.
author: ANN

title: Yu Hibari's 'Kokō na Kanojo to, Kanojo no Heya de Shiteru Koto' Light Novel Gets Manga
content: The July issue of Kadokawa 's Comic Alive magazine revealed on Wednesday that Yu Hibari 's Kokō na Kanojo to, Kanojo no Heya de Shiteru Koto light novel is inspiring a manga adaptation by Mugiko that will launch in the magazine's next issue on June 27.
author: ANN

title: Cerridwen Introduces Herself in Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 Episode 8 Preview
content: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 has revealed the preview images and synopsis for Episode 8 (Episode 20 overall). The preview features Cerridwen, the mysterious witch who appeared at the end of the previous episode.
author: Anime Corner

title: BAKI-DOU: The Invincible Samurai Part 2 Reveals Main Visual, June 18 Premiere for All 12 Episodes
content: BAKI-DOU: The Invincible Samurai Part 2 anime revealed the main visual and a June 18 premiere date. All twelve episodes of the anime will be released at once exclusively on Netflix. All 13 episodes of Part 1 were released on February 26, 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Comic Publisher Dark Horse's Workers Form Union
content: Employees at Dark Horse Comics and its retail store Things From Another World have formed a union on Wednesday named Dark Horse Workers United, affiliated with the Communications Workers of America (CWA).
author: ANN

title: Astra Awards Nominate Witch Hat Atelier, Dandelion, Sakamoto Days, JoJo Part 7, MAO, Rooster Fighter for Best Anime
content: The film critics in the Hollywood Creative Alliance (formerly the Hollywood Critics Association) announced their nominees for the 2026 Astra TV Awards on Wednesday. The nominees for Best Anime Series include: • Dandelion • MAO • Rooster Fighter • Sakamoto Days • STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure • Witch Hat…
author: ANN

title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis Anime Casts Hiroki Yasumoto as Cyborg 005
content: The staff of Ishimori Production 's Cyborg 009: Nemesis , a new anime based on Shōtarō Ishinomori 's Cyborg 009 manga, revealed on Thursday that Hiroki Yasumoto is joining the anime's cast as Cyborg 005/Geronimo Junior. Yūki Kaji plays the anime's main character Joe Shimamura/ Cyborg 009 .
author: ANN

title: Sou Hamayumiba's Dropout Idol Fruit Tart Manga Ends in 3 Chapters
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account of Houbunsha 's Manga Time Kirara magazine announced on Thursday that Sou Hamayumiba 's Dropout Idol Fruit Tart ( Ochikobore Fruit Tart ) manga will end in three chapters.
author: ANN

title: Immersive Pokémon Trainer Experience to Launch in Europe in Spring 2027
content: Real estate firm Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. announced on Tuesday that it will collaborate with Canadian multimedia studio Moment Factory and The Pokémon Company International to develop location-based entertainment and immersive entertainment based on the Pokémon franchise .
author: ANN

title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie Drops to #2 in Japan in 5th Weekend
content: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie — Nintendo , Illumination , and Universal Pictures ' sequel to The Super Mario Bros. Movie — dropped back from #1 to #2 in its fifth weekend. The film sold 203,000 tickets and earned 276,962,830 yen (about US$1.73 million) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN
